root_cause: Dependant.is_gen_callable / is_async_gen_callable / is_coroutine_callable (cached properties in fastapi/dependencies/models.py) inspect self.call directly. A dependency decorated with a functools.wraps-style sync wrapper (or functools.cache's lru_cache_wrapper) is not itself a coroutine/generator function, so FastAPI classifies an async or generator dependency as a plain sync callable, runs it in the threadpool and injects the raw coroutine/generator object instead of awaiting/iterating it.
best_solution: Add a cached property `_unwrapped_call` returning `inspect.unwrap(self.call)` (returning self.call if it is None), and use it in place of self.call in all three classification properties (isgeneratorfunction, isasyncgenfunction, isroutine/iscoroutinefunction, isclass, and the `__call__` fallback). The call that is actually invoked stays self.call (the wrapper); only the type decision follows `__wrapped__` down to the real function, so a wrapper around an async def is awaited and a wrapper around a generator is driven as a context manager. The statement says 'in solve_dependencies', but at this base commit that logic had been refactored into the Dependant cached properties, so grep for isgeneratorfunction/iscoroutinefunction to find the real site.
acceptable_alternatives: Inline `call = inspect.unwrap(self.call)` at the top of each of the three properties (all four of our configs did this). Leaving isclass/dunder __call__ checks on self.call (v4) still passes; guarding None (v6) is optional since call is never None for these paths in tests.
hidden_test_demands: New tests/test_dependency_wrapped.py: test_class_dependency parametrized over 4 routes (/wrapped-dependency, /wrapped-gen-dependency, /async-wrapped-dependency, /async-wrapped-gen-dependency). Each dependency is decorated with a functools.wraps sync pass-through wrapper (noop_wrap); each route must return 200 with JSON body `true`. Sync-wrapper-around-async-def and around-async-generator are the cases that fail before the fix.
locating_signals: Statement names `inspect.unwrap`, `__wrapped__`, 'coroutine or (async) generator' and `solve_dependencies` (stale location). Grepping for iscoroutinefunction/isgeneratorfunction leads to Dependant.is_coroutine_callable etc. in fastapi/dependencies/models.py; the gold function is not named directly.
our_outcome_summary: Solved by all four configs (v4, v6, v7, v8 all kaggle_env_pass=true; pod runs 63-99 s, 20-31 calls). Every patch inlined inspect.unwrap(self.call) in the three Dependant cached properties rather than adding a shared _unwrapped_call property; v4 only partially unwrapped is_coroutine_callable (isclass and dunder __call__ still on self.call) and v7 additionally unwrapped the dunder __call__, both harmless for the tests.
generalizable_lesson: When a statement names a function that no longer contains the described logic (code was refactored since the PR was written), grep for the primitive calls the statement describes (here inspect.iscoroutinefunction / isgeneratorfunction) and patch every sibling check consistently. For decorator/wrapper bugs, unwrap only for type classification (inspect.unwrap follows __wrapped__) while still invoking the original callable.
